target_customer: Crop insurers and insurance carriers that settle agricultural claims, starting with US crop insurance
problem: Verifying crop claims normally needs field visits. Verdex uses satellite imagery and other data streams so insurers can verify and settle claims from the desk.
business_model: B2B software for insurers (pricing not found)
product_category: AI claims verification using satellite imagery

founders.name: Jad Bousselham
founders.background_notes: YC page says he built a soybean yield prediction model using satellite imagery and is from Morocco; a search summary attributed the soybean model to Evan Rankin instead, so the attribution is uncertain.

competitors.name: EarthDaily
competitors.what: Satellite-verified analytics for underwriters and loss adjusters including remote claims verification

competitors.name: Descartes Labs and Planet Labs
competitors.what: Satellite analytics firms named by a March 2026 feature as possible entrants to insurance verification

competitors.name: ESA EO-INSURE
competitors.what: Publicly funded research project on agricultural damage verification and parametric triggers in southern Europe

technical_complexity.rationale: Turning satellite imagery into claim-grade yield loss estimates requires remote sensing and ML plus insurer integration; accuracy standards are demanding.

defensibility.rationale: Insurer relationships and validated models could compound, but satellite data is available to others and established vendors (EarthDaily and others) serve insurers.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent response found as of late 2026.

market_need_then: Crop insurance claims depend on field visits and manual adjusting; insurers and claims vendors in 2026 were adopting satellite and drone based loss verification.

branding.domain_note: Uses verdexai.com rather than verdex.com; an unrelated Verdex Technology exists.

identity.voice_and_tone: Short confident headline: Ground Truth For Smarter Insurance Decisions

brand_strength.rationale: Minimal site and no press about the brand itself; one third-party tier list noted the minimal public presence.

outcome_analysis: Verdex is a Winter 2026 two person team of Dartmouth graduates claiming to help insure over 11% of US farmland, a company-sourced figure that is unverified. No verified funding or outcome is public. Strengths are a focused crop insurance wedge and satellite expertise; risks are a thin public presence, limited insurance experience on the team and established satellite analytics vendors.
notes: Company website returned only a headline. The 11% of American farmland claim comes from the company and a magazine feature, unverified. One aggregator lists about $500K seed, not confirmed elsewhere, so not recorded as a round. Crunchbase and CB Insights entries for Verdex Technology appear unrelated. Competitor sources are 2026 pages near the W26 batch.
